title: Vietnamese Chicken & Vegetable Noodle Bowl
description: Shirataki noodles are composed of glucomannan, a viscous water-soluble fiber with zero digestible carbohydrates. Glucomannan slows carbohydrate breakdown and traps dietary cholesterol, aiding excretion.
diabeticNotes: Shirataki noodles are composed of glucomannan, a viscous water-soluble fiber with zero digestible carbohydrates. Glucomannan slows carbohydrate breakdown and traps dietary cholesterol, aiding excretion.

ingredients.name: packet Konjac / Shirataki noodles (rinsed and drained)

steps.title: Prep Shirataki Noodles
steps.description: Rinse shirataki noodles thoroughly in cold running water for 2 minutes. Parboil in boiling water for 1 minute, drain, and dry-fry in a hot skillet for 2 minutes to eliminate excess moisture.

steps.title: Whisk Nuoc Cham
steps.description: Whisk the lime juice, fish sauce, water, allulose sweetener, minced chili, and garlic in a small bowl until sweetener dissolves completely.

steps.title: Layer Noodle Base
steps.description: In a serving bowl, lay down the warm prepared shirataki noodles.

steps.title: Add Toppings
steps.description: Arrange shredded chicken breast, cabbage slaw, cucumber, mint, and cilantro neatly over noodles.

steps.title: Dress & Toss
steps.description: Pour dressing evenly over bowl and scatter crushed roasted peanuts over top. Toss before eating.
